changelog:
lab-cover-set 0.1.1

- Improved guidance for collecting assignment names and points: only use user-supplied data, never invent.
- Clarifies destination (print, slide, screen), language, and brand matching as user options.
- Adds strict instructions to cap lab cover packs at 8 stills, minimum 4 unless user supplies fewer.
- Updated approval and billing workflow: explicit, itemized confirmation before first paid call.
- Clearer references to dedicated workflow and update documents.
- Execution and update process must exclusively use bundled scripts with official sources.
summary: Turn user-supplied assignment names and points into a four-to-eight still lab cover set. This lab report cover studio lays out each named assignment as its own still. Use it for assignment covers, experiment covers, lab report stills, and a matching cover pack.
